column1: Peer Code Review Grading rev. FA26
column3: One PDF with your name, group number, a note on what your teammates reviewed, and for BOTH reviews: repo link, PR link, a link to the comments you left, and a screenshot of those comments.
column6: Complete PDF. Links and screenshots present for both reviews.
column9: Missing some links or screenshots, or covers only one of the two reviews.
column12: No PDF, or a PDF with no links and no screenshots.

column1: Peer Code Review Grading rev. FA26
column3: The review actually left on the PR: at least 2 line-anchored comments plus 1 summary comment per PR, submitted as a Comment review. Approve and Request changes are not allowed on another team's PR.
column6: Both PRs have 2 or more line-anchored comments plus a summary comment, submitted as Comment.
column9: Only one PR got a proper review, or the second lacks line-anchored comments.
column12: Reviewed in the PDF but left little or nothing on the PR itself.
column15: Nothing posted on GitHub, or used Approve or Request changes.

column1: Peer Code Review Grading rev. FA26
column3: Each comment names a concrete thing in the code and says what could change. Looks good and bad naming are not reviews.
column6: Comments point at specific code and propose a change the author can act on.
column9: Some comments are specific; the rest are generic praise or vague criticism.
column12: Comments are generic or cannot be acted on.

column1: Peer Code Review Grading rev. FA26
column3: Written answers for the first PR: the process questions (issue addressed, reviewers assigned, tests, changes made) and the code questions (design, functionality, complexity, naming, comments, style, documentation).
column6: Addresses 6 or more dimensions in complete sentences, grounded in the actual code.
column9: Addresses 3 to 5 dimensions, or answers are one-word or not grounded in the code.
column12: Fewer than 3 dimensions addressed, or no analysis for this PR.

column1: Peer Code Review Grading rev. FA26
column3: Same as review 1, for the second PR from your other target group.
column6: Addresses 6 or more dimensions in complete sentences, grounded in the actual code.
column9: Addresses 3 to 5 dimensions, or answers are one-word or not grounded in the code.
column12: Fewer than 3 dimensions addressed, or no analysis for this PR.

column1: Peer Code Review Grading rev. FA26
column3: Who reviewed you, what they said, and a concrete sentence starting With this feedback I will. If nobody reviewed you, self-review your own latest PR instead and say that is what you did.
column6: Records the reviewer and their feedback, and commits to a specific concrete change.
column9: Records the feedback but the response is vague or amounts to no change.
column12: No record of feedback received and no self-review substitute.

column1: Peer Code Review Grading rev. FA26
column3: Feedback critiques the code rather than the person, and is written the way you would want a reviewer to talk to you.
column9: Dismissive, personal, or careless in tone.
